chunks.en_text: 4.1. Bhadda Kapilani

parts.text: 4.1. Bhadda Kapilani

chunks.en_text: Son of the Buddha and his heir is he, Great Kassapa — his mind serene, collected. Vision of previous lives is his, Heaven and hell he penetrates.

parts.text: Son of the Buddha and his heir is he,
Great Kassapa — his mind serene, collected.
Vision of previous lives is his,
Heaven and hell he penetrates.

chunks.en_text: The ceasing of rebirth he has obtained, And supernormal knowledge he has mastered. With these three knowledges possessed by him He is a brahman true, of threefold knowledge.

parts.text: The ceasing of rebirth he has obtained,
And supernormal knowledge he has mastered.
With these three knowledges possessed by him
He is a brahman true, of threefold knowledge.

chunks.en_text: So has she, too, Bhadda the Kapilani, gained for herself The threefold knowledge and has vanquished death. Having bravely vanquished Mara and his host, It is the last formation of a body that she bears.

parts.text: So has she, too, Bhadda the Kapilani, gained for herself
The threefold knowledge and has vanquished death.
Having bravely vanquished Mara and his host,
It is the last formation of a body that she bears.

chunks.en_text: Seeing the world's deep misery, we both went forth And are now both free of cankers, with well-tamed minds. Cooled of passions, we have found deliverance; Cooled of passions, we have found our freedom.

parts.text: Seeing the world's deep misery, we both went forth
And are now both free of cankers, with well-tamed minds.
Cooled of passions, we have found deliverance;
Cooled of passions, we have found our freedom.

chunks.en_text: Chapter 5

parts.text: Chapter 5

chunks.en_text: 5.9. Bhadda Kundalakesa: The Former Jain Ascetic

parts.text: 5.9. Bhadda Kundalakesa: The Former Jain Ascetic

chunks.en_text: I traveled before in a single cloth, With shaven head, covered in dust, Thinking of faults in the faultless, While in the faulty seeing no faults.

parts.text: I traveled before in a single cloth,
With shaven head, covered in dust,
Thinking of faults in the faultless,
While in the faulty seeing no faults.

chunks.en_text: When done was the day's abiding, I went to Mount Vulture Peak And saw the stainless Buddha By the Order of Bhikkhus revered.

parts.text: When done was the day's abiding,
I went to Mount Vulture Peak
And saw the stainless Buddha
By the Order of Bhikkhus revered.

chunks.en_text: Then before Him my hands in añjali Humbly, I bowed down on my knees. "Come, Bhadda," He said to me: And thus was I ordained.

parts.text: Then before Him my hands in añjali
Humbly, I bowed down on my knees.
"Come, Bhadda," He said to me:
And thus was I ordained.

chunks.en_text: Debt-free, I traveled for fifty years In Anga, Magadha and Vajji, In Kasi and Kosala, too, Living on the alms of the land.

parts.text: Debt-free, I traveled for fifty years
In Anga, Magadha and Vajji,
In Kasi and Kosala, too,
Living on the alms of the land.

chunks.en_text: That lay-supporter — wise man indeed — May many merits accrue to him! Who gave a robe to Bhadda for Free of all ties is she.

parts.text: That lay-supporter — wise man indeed —
May many merits accrue to him!
Who gave a robe to Bhadda for
Free of all ties is she.

chunks.en_text: 6.4. The Verses of Final Knowledge of Bhikkhuni Sujata

parts.text: 6.4. The Verses of Final Knowledge of Bhikkhuni Sujata

chunks.en_text: With subtle veils adorned, Garlands and sandal-wood bedecked, Covered all over with ornaments, Surrounded by my servants,

parts.text: With subtle veils adorned,
Garlands and sandal-wood bedecked,
Covered all over with ornaments,
Surrounded by my servants,

chunks.en_text: Taking with us food and drink, Eatables of many kinds, Setting off from the house, To the forest grove we took it all.

parts.text: Taking with us food and drink,
Eatables of many kinds,
Setting off from the house,
To the forest grove we took it all.

chunks.en_text: Having enjoyed and sported there, We turned our feet to home But on the way I saw and entered Near Saketa, a monastery.

parts.text: Having enjoyed and sported there,
We turned our feet to home
But on the way I saw and entered
Near Saketa, a monastery.

chunks.en_text: Seeing the Light of the World I drew near, bowed down to Him; Out of compassion the Seeing One Then taught me Dhamma there.

parts.text: Seeing the Light of the World
I drew near, bowed down to Him;
Out of compassion the Seeing One
Then taught me Dhamma there.

chunks.en_text: Hearing the words of the Great Sage, I penetrated Truth: The Dhamma passionless, I touched the Dhamma of Deathlessness.

parts.text: Hearing the words of the Great Sage,
I penetrated Truth:
The Dhamma passionless,
I touched the Dhamma of Deathlessness.

chunks.en_text: When the True Dhamma had been known, I went forth to the homeless life; The three True Knowledges are attained, Not empty the Buddha's Teaching!

parts.text: When the True Dhamma had been known,
I went forth to the homeless life;
The three True Knowledges are attained,
Not empty the Buddha's Teaching!

chunks.en_text: Chapter 6

chunks.en_text: Maha Pajapati (Gotami) Theri: A Mother's Blessing

parts.text: Maha Pajapati (Gotami) Theri: A Mother's Blessing

chunks.en_text: Buddha! Hero! Praise be to you! You foremost among all beings! You who have released me from pain, And so many other beings too.

parts.text: Buddha! Hero! Praise be to you!
You foremost among all beings!
You who have released me from pain,
And so many other beings too.

chunks.en_text: All suffering has been understood. The source of craving has withered. Cessation has been touched by me On the noble eight-fold path.

parts.text: All suffering has been understood.
The source of craving has withered.
Cessation has been touched by me
On the noble eight-fold path.

chunks.en_text: I've been mother and son before; And father, brother — grandmother too. Not understanding what was real, I flowed-on without finding [peace].

parts.text: I've been mother and son before;
And father, brother — grandmother too.
Not understanding what was real,
I flowed-on without finding [peace].

chunks.en_text: But now I've seen the Blessed One! This is my last compounded form. The on-flowing of birth has expired. There's no more re-becoming now.

parts.text: But now I've seen the Blessed One!
This is my last compounded form.
The on-flowing of birth has expired.
There's no more re-becoming now.

chunks.en_text: See the gathering of followers: Putting forth effort, self controlled, Always with strong resolution —This is how to honor the Buddhas!

parts.text: See the gathering of followers:
Putting forth effort, self controlled,
Always with strong resolution
—This is how to honor the Buddhas!

chunks.en_text: Surely for the good of so many Did Maya give birth to Gotama, Who bursts asunder the mass of pain Of those stricken by sickness and death.

parts.text: Surely for the good of so many
Did Maya give birth to Gotama,
Who bursts asunder the mass of pain
Of those stricken by sickness and death.
